user.title: Connect your Luka mirror
user.description: Enter the mirror's IP address or hostname. Home Assistant must be able to reach it on your local network.

reconfigure.title: Change mirror address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the same mirror. To add a different mirror, create a separate integration entry.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the mirror's light state. Check its address and local network connection.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without a URL scheme or path.
